verdict.rationale: Typesense is open source and self-hostable, and Typesense Cloud is described as the hosted version of that same open-source product, so a user is not locked into the vendor and can leave by running it themselves. The pack also shows data going in as CSV/JSON, but nothing shows a documented way to export data back out in open formats. Missing for 10: documented export endpoint or tool (e.g. JSONL document export), evidence of exporting schemas and config (synonyms, curation), a documented Cloud-to-self-host migration path, and independent hands-on corroboration of a full export.
